question: Whom should one contemplate in all knowledges and mantras according to this instruction?
premises: The instruction applies to all knowledges.
The instruction applies to all mantras.
Varuṇa is the object of contemplation.
inference: One should contemplate Varuṇa in all knowledges and in all mantras.
plain_english: O beloved, contemplate Varuṇa in all knowledges and in all mantras.
